text:
zoe: Quick report from the onboarding workshop: embeddings + rerank batch behavior looks inconsistent in the JS SDK. Single calls fine, batches sometimes produce weird shapes or merged results.

zoe: Repro (fast): call client.embeddings.create({ input: ['one','two'] }) in sample-app. Server JSON is correct, but SDK sometimes returns embeddings like [ [v1], v2 ] or flat [v1, v2] where v1 length==3072.

nate: do you see this when token refresh is disabled? could be retry merging partial bodies.

zoe: it stabilizes when I disable token refresh. With refresh enabled and two parallel batches, I see duplicated vectors or ordering swapped.

anya: sounds like two independent issues: 1) batching helper fast-path unwraps single-item arrays leading to inconsistent shapes; 2) retry/refresh flow merges partial stream chunks instead of re-requesting full response.

nate: agreed. Also spotted rerank responses sometimes using field "scores" vs "rankings" across minor versions — param parity issue in SDK. Sample-app expects a stable key.

zoe: minimal fix plan I validated locally: add normalizeBatchEmbeddings(resp) that coerces to Array<Array<number>> and validates vector length against model dims; make retry logic drop partial buffer and reissue full request after auth refresh.

anya: file a tracker issue and small patch in SDK. I'll add unit tests: simulate token expiry mid-stream, simulate single-item fast-path mixed with batch path.

nate: also add a clear runtime error: EmbeddingShapeError with expected dims and actual shape to help new devs in onboarding (right now they hit a cryptic TypeError).

dev-tools-bot: Created issue DEVEX-4622 "js-sdk: normalize embedding batch shapes + prevent retry merge" by anya (https://tracker/redwood/DEVEX-4622).

zoe: will update sample-app to call ensureVectors(resp) helper and add a short README note to run the validation script after SDK bump.

anya: PR drafted, will include normalization helper and tests. Will ping here when ready for QA.

nate: thanks — if QA reproduces server-side corruption we'll reopen but this looks client-side.

zoe: confirmed local fix; leaving for CI and QA. Thanks!
